verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.requesty.ai that describes the product, and doc pages are served as markdown with an embedded pointer telling agents to fetch the full index from llms.txt. That is agent-oriented docs an agent can be pointed at directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that explicitly describes or promotes the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar complete-content bundle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
